{{Quote|My son Jowres and daughter Mia were attacked by those beasts outside. Both of them are sick and need medical attention!|[[Larence Zaprin]], to a medic|<ref name="SWG:HC" />}}
'''Mia Zaprin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] with [[Zaprin family|her family]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Heard howling. Jowy and I went outside to check. Terrible pain. Screaming. Mine? No...no no! No more!|Mia Zaprin, to a medic|<ref name="SWG:HC" />}}
[[File:Zaprin_Estate_exterior.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The [[Zaprin Estate]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Mia Zaprin lived at the remote [[Zaprin Estate]] in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] with her father [[Larence Zaprin|Larence]], her mother and her brother [[Jowres Zaprin|Jowres]].<ref name="SWG:HC" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of sick [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatchs]] and [[Mott/Legends|motts]] surrounded the Zaprin's home. Mia and her brother [[Jowres Zaprin|Jowres]] went outside to check the situation but were attacked by the crazed animals. Mia was bitten in the leg and developed a severe infection that caused her to fall into a delirium. Her worried father sent an urgent call for help and soon a [[Medic/Legends|medic]] sent by the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B droid]] [[2-1b-58|Billingsly]] arrived at the Zaprin Estate. He examined Mia and tried to cure her illness, but the infection didn't respond to the treatment. So the medic single-handedly killed several of the feral creatures that surrounded the house. From blood samples extracted from the creatures' bodies, the medic was able to create an anti-toxin. After an injection with the new medicine, Mia quickly recovered from her illness.<ref name="SWG:HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Mia_Zaprin.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Two randomly-generated depictions of Mia Zaprin.]]
[[File:TemplateCommonerHumanFemale.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Mia Zaprin.]]
Mia Zaprin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Mia Zaprin was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

Mia Zaprin could be found in a remote building in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] southeast of the [[Varykino/Legends|Lake Retreat]]. She was part of the quest "[[W:c:swg:House Call|House Call]]" for players of the [[:w:c:swg:Medic|Medic profession]]. During each server reset, Mia Zaprin's appearance was randomized, but she consistently appeared as a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="SWG:HC" />
